name: io.github.Orphograph/orphograph
description: Anchor a file's SHA-256 fingerprint to Bitcoin. The file never leaves the device.

environmentVariables.name: ORPHO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key issued from https://orphograph.com/account.html. Without it, anchors are subject to the free-tier rate limit (three anchors per twenty-four hours per IP). With it, the customer's subscription or Pack credits apply.

environmentVariables.name: ORPHO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Orphograph API. Defaults to https://orphograph.com. Override only for testing or self-hosted instances.

environmentVariables.name: ORPHO_X402_PAYER_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a chmod-600 file holding the hex private key of a dedicated Base wallet with USDC. With ORPHO_X402_DAILY_CAP_CENTS set too, anchors past the free tier are paid with x402 (1 cent today). The key never leaves the machine.

environmentVariables.name: ORPHO_X402_DAILY_CAP_CENTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The most this server may pay in one UTC day, in cents. Paying stays off unless this and ORPHO_X402_PAYER_KEY_FILE are both set.

environmentVariables.name: ORPHO_X402_MAX_CENTS_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The most one anchor may cost, in cents. Default 5.

title: Orphograph
